description: A */0 expression raises ZeroDivisionError in next_run; the issue talks mostly about the caller.

issue.title: Scheduler blows up with ZeroDivisionError for a `*/0` job
issue.body:
I add jobs with `schedule_job` and nothing complains, but as soon as `run_due` runs:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "scheduler/runner.py", line 14, in run_due
    if next_run(expr, now) <= now:
  File "scheduler/cron.py", line 5, in next_run
    return now + (step - now % step) % step
ZeroDivisionError: integer modulo by zero
```

I would expect a clear error instead of a ZeroDivisionError.
